I knew that most people who chose to wear glasses would get stronger and stronger prescriptions.

My wife recently dragged me along with her to an eye place. I did want glasses for a special purpose, not wearing them all the time, and got tested.

My left eye had only very slight (-0.25 diopter) "need" for distance correction, while my right eye "needed" -1.00 diopter.

I ordered glasses only plugging in my own idea, which was to use the full astigmatism correction but give both eyes -0.25 distance correction.

An eye doctor would have said, I'm sure, that I couldn't possibly see 20/15 getting only -0.25 distance correction when every test said I "needed" -1.0.

I am figuring, if I improved by 0.75 diopter that fast, probably I can improve the remaining bit, so the next pair will have no distance correction for either eye and I bet I won't need it.
